# Awesome Mise

[![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)
[![Validate Catalog](https://github.com/carlosferreyra/awesome-mise/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/carlosferreyra/awesome-mise/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Discover what is possible with [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/): a curated collection of tools,
workflows, integrations, and real-world configurations.

Find a useful starting point for managing project tools, automating everyday work, connecting
services, or sharing a working environment. Copyable configurations are a central part of this
list. Contributions can cover personal, team, and operational workflows across ecosystems.

This list complements the [official registry](https://mise.jdx.dev/registry.html) with use cases
and practical context. It is intentionally selective. Tools are installable through mise;
integrations connect mise to other systems; recipes are reusable configurations; learning
resources explain how to put them to work. These labels describe the resource, not a verification level.

## Try a recipe

Install mise using the [official instructions](https://mise.jdx.dev/installing-mise.html).
Copy a recipe's `mise.toml` into a new directory, inspect it, then run its listed command there.
If mise requests trust, review the file before running `mise trust`. Merge deliberately when
adapting a recipe to an existing project. The initial recipes use POSIX shell commands and need
no tool installations. They are small building blocks; community configurations should explain
their prerequisites and provenance.
